name: Royal Banquet Hall
introDiscord:
Seven enormous royal seals decorate the doors of the kingdom's grand
banquet hall.

Inside, tables stretch farther than some palace corridors.

The banquet ended centuries ago.

Shizuki still found a seat.
introTwitch:
Seven enormous royal seals decorate the doors of the kingdom's grand
banquet hall.

Inside, tables stretch farther than some palace corridors.

The banquet ended centuries ago.

Shizuki still found a seat.

the-seven-royal-seals-approach.prompt: Royal Banquet Hall opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A servants' station contains restorative salts.

Shizuki wrote:

'Table seats approximately eight billion people.

I chose center seat.

Power move.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Royal Oath Construct activates beside the sealed banquet doors.

forward.message: A serving cabinet contains Star Candies.

the-seven-royal-seals-depths.prompt: Deeper within Royal Banquet Hall, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
One Berry rests on a royal plate.

A place card beside it reads:

'LADY SHIZUKI OF HOUSE BERRY.'

The handwriting is extremely familiar.

right.message: A banquet chest contains sealed Star Candies.

forward.message: A Construct patrols between the enormous tables.

the-seven-royal-seals-threshold.prompt: Near Royal Banquet High Table, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A Royal Oath Construct blocks the high table.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle:

'Royal dinner medicine.

Required after Attempting Ancient Recipe.

See kitchen incident.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A golden serving tray contains Star Candies.

boss-antechamber.name: Royal Banquet High Table
boss-antechamber.prompt: All seven seals around the banquet hall light simultaneously.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Royal Banquet High Table. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The banquet hall falls quiet.

Shizuki's place card remains at the table.

House Berry finally has official seating.
